665:t_008:21.en:
$$トライア$$
「...So what shall we do now, Captain $$ジェフリー$$?」

665:t_008:22.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「First we'll return to the $$フロンティア船団$$ and check the situation in the surrounding area. Heading for the galactic center comes after that.」

665:t_008:25.en:
$$モニカ$$
「The $$フロンティア船団$$ is about to enter fold!」

665:t_009:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Are you planning to go off somewhere and leave us behind!?」

665:t_009:1.en:
$$カイエン$$
「What's the meaning of this!? Are you saying the fleet has been taken over by someone!?」

665:t_009:2.en:
$$三島$$
「That is not the case, members of $c.」

665:t_009:4.en:
$$三島$$
「We will act separately from you. You may as well call this a break with the humanity of Earth.」

665:t_009:6.en:
$$赤木$$
「What are you saying in a situation like this!?」

665:t_009:7.en:
$$葵$$
「You mean you're running away from the decisive battle with $$バアル$$!?」

665:t_009:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But if you act on your own here, all you'll get is attacked by the $$宇宙怪獣$$ and the $$ギャラクシー船団$$!」

665:t_009:10.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The $$フロンティア船団$$ has already...!」

665:t_009:11.en:
$$三島$$
「Exactly. We have already formed an alliance with the $$ギャラクシー船団$$.」

665:t_009:12.en:
$$三島$$
「In other words, we have obtained the power of the $$バジュラ$$.」

665:t_009:13.en:
$$グレイス#keyword$$
「With this power, even the $$宇宙怪獣$$ are nothing to fear. And depending on the situation, we could even jump to a parallel world.」

665:t_009:16.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Aide $$三島$$. Has this already been approved by $$大統領$$ $$ハワード・グラス$$?」

665:t_009:17.en:
$$三島$$
「A new order has already been established in the fleet. The old chain of offices and organizational structure no longer mean anything.」

665:t_009:18.en:
$$三島$$
「Therefore, it is useless for you to denounce my past conduct.」

665:t_009:19.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Damn it! That man... $$グレイス・オコナー$$ played him, and ambition has possessed him once again!」

665:t_009:20.en:
$$三島$$
「Before we set off for our new land, I thought I might repay you for all the trouble you caused us...」

665:t_009:21.en:
$$三島$$
「But that is a trivial matter now.」

665:t_009:22.en:
$$ボビー$$
「Sore loser! You're just a man who hid and watched the battles against the Empire and the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$!」

665:t_009:23.en:
$$三島$$
「I'd prefer you say I was biding my time. ...But now, the sleeping lion has awakened.」

665:t_009:24.en:
$$グレイス#keyword$$
「The fold preparations will be complete shortly.」

665:t_009:25.en:
$$三島$$
「Then let us depart. To our new land... to Frontier, guarded by the $$バジュラ$$ queen.」

665:t_009:27.en:
$$グレイス#keyword$$
「That's right, $$ブレラ・スターン$$. That planet is the $$バジュラ$$ homeworld.」

665:t_010:0.en:
$$三島$$
「Even we didn't expect to fold out so close to the $$バジュラ$$ homeworld. Thanks to that, we had to move our plan up.」

665:t_010:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「No! If we attack while they're preparing to fold, the fleet will be in danger!」

665:t_010:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「Damn it! $$シェリル$$ is over there!」

665:t_010:4.en:
???
「Even a Wingless will cry out when torn away from someone they love, it seems.」

665:t_011:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Now you must understand a little of my pain.」

665:t_011:2.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Bastard! You followed us all the way out here!?」

665:t_011:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「What a conceited Wingless. You're no longer even on my radar.」

665:t_011:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「But since we're here, let's play for a little while before the fight with them.」

665:t_012:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The dimensional boundary line is warping rapidly!」

665:t_012:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh... I invite you to the labyrinth of love and hate.」

665:t_013:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Ha ha ha ha ha! Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!」

665:t_014:2.en:
$$モニカ$$
「We can't confirm the $$フロンティア船団$$ or the new $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3!」

665:t_014:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The distortion values of the dimensional boundary line around us are as stable as normal space!」

665:t_014:4.en:
$$トライア$$
「This is bad! If there's no crack, we can't break through the wall of spacetime!」

665:t_014:6.en:
$$レド$$
「We've been trapped in this space...!」

665:t_015:0.en:
$$ブレラ$$
(You who were controlled by the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ are the same as I once was...)

665:t_015:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
(So I swear...! That I will surely crush their ambitions and set you free...!)

665:t_016:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Increase in this unit's combat strength confirmed.」

665:t_016:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「A $$マシンキャリバー$$'s combat strength is determined by the interaction between pilot and interface.」

665:t_016:3.en:
$$レド$$
「So you mean we're getting stronger.」

665:t_016:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「That is judged to be a more accurate expression.」

665:t_016:5.en:
$$レド$$
「We won't fall behind a $$ストライカー#robot$$ anymore.」

665:t_016:6.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「All $$ストライカー#robot$$s sortieing on this battlefield are inferred to be slaves of $$ストライカー・Ｘ３７５２#robot$$.」

665:t_016:7.en:
$$レド$$
「To stop these guys, we have no choice but to hit the original $$ストライカー#robot$$.」

665:t_016:8.en:
$$レド$$
「Chamber... That is the job of us, who were Alliance soldiers.」

665:t_016:9.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. That instruction is set as the highest-priority item.」

665:t_100:0.en:
$$アルト$$
(Being controlled by someone and forced to do what you don't want... That must be bitter for you...)

665:t_100:1.en:
$$アルト$$
(Hold on...! I'll definitely free you from those $$ギャラクシー船団$$ guys!)

665:t_101:0.en:
$$ブレラ$$
(The $$ギャラクシー船団$$, which has obtained the power of the $$バジュラ$$...)

665:t_101:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
(What are they after...? What are they plotting at this point...?)

665:t_102:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The combat strength of the attack targets is judged equivalent to the $$ストライカー#robot$$ types fought on Earth.」

665:t_102:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Also, as they carry the same line of interface, no gaps are seen in their tactical coordination.」

665:t_102:2.en:
$$レド$$
「Originally, $$マシンキャリバー$$ combat is premised on coordination among multiple units.」

665:t_102:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「However, this unit is employing tactics that deviate from that principle.」
